COMMAND CODE

Community & game rules

Keep the Reach fair, respectful and welcoming.

01

Respect other players

No harassment, hateful language, threats or sharing another person’s private information. Keep discussions and alliance diplomacy respectful.

02

Fair play

Do not exploit bugs, automate abusive actions, evade restrictions or access accounts and private intelligence without permission. Report suspected exploits privately to staff.

03

Accounts & passkeys

Protect your password and personal Owner passkey. Share alliance intelligence only within the permissions granted to you.

04

Forums & media

Keep posts relevant. No spam, impersonation or unlawful content. Cinematic AI battle clips are labelled as concepts and do not represent live combat results.

05

Staff support & appeals

Use User Profile → Support tickets for staff help or a ban appeal. Include the relevant dates and a clear explanation. Staff review is required; submitting an appeal does not lift a restriction automatically.

06

Practice rounds & resets

This site contains a practice simulation. Round resets clear gameplay data; saved identity and account access remain. The manual explains each system and its limitations.
